population.rule: Reconstruct each request as c02_prompt+1 through c02_prompt+incremental_decode_forwards, then select nearest observed min/q25/p50/q75/max.

decode_attention_standby.scope: QK^T one-head primitive shapes for OPE5; layer-call and equivalent eight-head invocation counts are kept separate.

ple_scope.included: PLE context projection, input gate, residual projection

decode_weight_traffic_accounts.adjudication: The card's 3,890,216,960-byte value is reproduced exactly but is not all 343 linear calls: it excludes 82,575,360 bytes across 85 PLE calls in addition to excluding lm_head. OPE4 must show both scopes and use the 3,972,792,320-byte account when claiming all non-lm-head linear weights.

claim_limits: Analytic IO bytes are compulsory A/B reads plus C write, not measured DRAM traffic.
B0-reference prefill anchors are not observed C02 rendered shapes.
The 3,890,216,960-byte legacy/card account excludes PLE and lm_head; the all-343-linear account is 3,972,792,320 bytes before lm_head.
The 3,972,792,320-byte analytic weight account is numerically equal to an M0 IOVA mapping size; arithmetic equality alone does not prove that allocation's identity or contents.
lm_head 16-bit serialization is a storage fact; its board compute-path width remains unproven and is therefore split into hypotheses.
Attention standby rows describe one-head QK^T primitives; eight-head multiplicity is explicit and not folded into the shape dimensions.
